
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/bugshare/p/19186478" title="发布于 2025-11-03 11:01">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">嘿嘿，猜我刚刚发现了什么？IDEA全新UI，极致优雅贼好看！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>🚀️ 嘿嘿，最近在IDEA的设置里发现了个小惊喜——JetBrains悄咪咪上架了两款新主题（目前还是Beta版），按江湖规矩，粉丝优先尝鲜，直接上图！</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Islands Dark：</p>
<p><img alt="image-20251103091030496.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251103105031419-425787719.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Islands Light：</p>
<p><img alt="image-20251103091122859.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251103105032768-396381205.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>怎么样？是不是一眼就觉得清爽了不少？简单概括就俩字：优雅，贼好看！</p>
<p><strong>😄 啥？你说没看出太大区别？那咱们直接对比一下：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Dark VS Islands Dark</p>
<p><img alt="1762134942376.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251103105029841-974164307.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Light VS Islands Light</p>
<p><img alt="1762135508413.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251103105033428-698580340.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>👀️ 前后对比，一眼可见的升级：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>编辑器区域和工具窗口的视觉区分更明显了</li>
<li>导航栏和标签页更加突出，一目了然</li>
<li>整体风格转向更现代、更清新的视觉效果</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>🎉️ 废话不多说，上手试试！</strong></p>
<p>只需将IDEA升级到最新版，进入 <code>Settings -&gt; Appearance &amp; Behavior -&gt; Appearance -&gt; Theme</code>，在下拉菜单中选中 “Islands” 主题即可一键换新。</p>
<p><img alt="image-20251103100148320.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251103105028510-944722281.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
